title: Athletic Hourglass (Toned, Tan, Fit & Ready)
author: Silli
desc:
"I'm just a girl" — Perfect, run this program and you'll end up as "just a locked-in, athletic, fit girl". Like CrossFit if it was cooler & cared about glutes.

The purpose of this program is to become suspiciously athletic without sacrificing the hourglass agenda. Do you want to look like "that girl"? Ok, run this program. Do you want to "tone the muscle"? Ok, run this program. Do you not want to get "too bulky"? Ok, run this program. Do you want "functional muscle"? Ok, run this program. Do you like to go to the beach? Ok, run this program. Do breath air? Ok, RUN THIS PROGRAM!!!!

Get a crazy x frame with wide hips and a small waist by running this program!

ex.note: GOAL IS PUMP. Squeeze, chase pump
GOAL IS STRETCH. Slow, Stretch, deep stretch of glute. front foot 2-4in elevated, long stride, slight forward torso lean
GOAL IS PUMP. SQUEEZE HARDDDDD
GOAL IS STRECTH. Dig down with the heel rather than press. Feel hamstrings and glutes as you push. Slow, eccentric, feel > weight

ss.note: STRETCH + PUMP. Go as wide as possible and squeeze hard. Extend legs out as far as possible to make it harder.
FINSIHER. Go AS HARD as possible. Destroy your quads.
HSPU progression. Focus on shoulder stimulus. Try to get as verical as possible, work into a HSPU
Let your lats stretch and pull apart horizontally. Stretch + squeeze.

ex.note: Upper/mid back focused

ss.note: Push these heavy and try to add weight. Go deep.
CONTROL >> Else Dont let the shoulder or elbow move. Keep reps slow. Only curl 3/4 of the way up (stop when it gets easier/at the top).
Focus on the rear delts and deeper scapula muscles here.
Done VIZ style, try to PUMP as much as possible.

ex.note: Try to STRETCH here and control as best as possible.
PUMP FOCUSED. Get nasty here. Burn
STRETCH FOCUSED. Destroy your quads but be safe as well. Slow eccentrics, no bouncing. Mental strength.
PUMP FOCUSED. SQUEEZE HARDDDDD at the top
STRETCH FOCUSED. LIGHT. Be SLOW, use less weight and reach the bar to the toes. Mind muscle connection focus.
FINISHER. DONT make these too light. MAKE THESE HARD. 8-10 per leg.
STRETCH FOCUSED. Slow eccentric, 3 FULL second pause at the botttom of the rep.

ss.note: HEAVY. Push these to the limit with weight, but also CLEARLY get the chin over each rep. CONTROL ECCENTRIC 50%. NOT DROPPING, NOT SOOOO SLOW.
Realllllly try to focus on chest mind muscle connection. Controlled, squeeze, should have insaneee pump.

ex.note: PUMP FOCUSED. Get the shoulders warmed up and pumped.
STRETCH FOCUSED. Be safe and slow with these, working up in weight slowly. Micropause at bottom of each rep. Almost trying to squeeze your fists together as you press upward.

ss.note: UPPER BACK SQUEEZE FOCUSED. ELBOW OUT AT 90* to the side of your head. **NOT ELBOW AT HIP**
PUMP FOCUSED. Elbow goes backwwards on the way up, and press down and slightly in front of you on the way down. LOAD HEAVY, LOOSER FORM, but WARMUP THOROUGHLY.
CONTROL >> Else Dont let the shoulder or elbow move. Keep reps slow. Only curl 3/4 of the way up (stop when it gets easier/at the top).
Done VIZ style, try to PUMP as much as possible.
STRETCH FOCUSED, Dont go TOO deep, but go very slow on the eccentric and focus on mind muscle connection here.
STRETCH FOCUSED. FINISHER FOR ABS, destroy your torso with these. Deep as possible.
